purpose: Repeat the notebook 01-03 2D AE/propagator and latent-coverage experiments on MetaForge trajectories saved every 200 MD steps, using exact frames 0-499.
model: Fresh 2D message_passing_reference16 AE and frozen one-step delta_mlp propagator; same architecture, coordinate-only objective, optimizer and checkpoint rules as the 1000-step study.
training: One ordinary warmup epoch followed by at most 60 uniformly weighted all-frame AE epochs; no early-frame upweighting. Propagator uses all 499 one-step transitions and at most 60 epochs.

postfit.low_temperature_primary: physical fixed-frame0 quantile-0.10 endpoint p-ratio at frame499
postfit.mixed_temperature_primary: normalized boundary-strain affine OLS over frames150-499, p=-slope
postfit.mixed_fit_window_reason: frame150 is MD step30000, preserving the previous estimator's physical start point
postfit.retained_diagnostics: AE reconstruction and autonomous rollout separately at every frame, source-wise valid/total; mixed endpoint also retained

qualification: The requested 500-frame prefix ends at MD step99800 and is not a horizon-matched replacement for the earlier 200x1000 run ending at199000.
